name: TAL_IV
comments: Talinolol (Cordanum) and carbamazepine (Finlepsin retard) were purchased from Arzneimittelwerk Dresden GmbH (Dresden, Germany).

name: TAL_PO
comments: oral talinolol, fast-releasing tablets containing 100 mg talinolol were swallowed after overnight fasting at 8 AM for 19 days. An individual breakfast was allowed 1 hour later. This long-term treatment started on the 11th study day.

name: CBZ
comments: After 12 hours, 600 mg carbamazepine was given orally with 200 mL tap water.
